visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with an intentional out-of-focus bokeh effect. Two humanoid figures, one predominantly red and the other black, stand in the center of the frame against a nighttime urban backdrop. Multi-colored light circles from city buildings fill the screen, obscuring specific details of the characters and the setting. This visual style creates a sense of mystery before the subject is revealed clearly. (2) The image suddenly transitions into sharp focus, revealing two people dressed in Spider-Man costumes. The figure on the left is in the classic red-and-blue suit, while the figure on the right is in the black-and-white suit. They both perform a synchronized pose with their arms extended, mimicking web-shooting gestures. The iconic Taipei 101 skyscraper is visible in the background, illuminated against the dark night sky. (3) In a seamless motion, the two characters grab their masks at the top and pull them off simultaneously. They reveal two young women with long, straight black hair and porcelain skin. Their facial expressions are calm as they look directly into the camera. The brightly lit Taipei 101 tower stands prominently behind them, providing a high-contrast urban background with various city lights. (4) The two women begin a coordinated dance routine, swaying their hips and moving their hands in time with the music. The lighting on their faces is bright and even, likely from an external source like a ring light. The red-suited woman is on the left, and the black-suited woman is on the right. They look confident and engaged, performing for the camera while the dark skyline remains static.
